parks.name: Shenandoah National Park
parks.blurb: Blue Ridge mountain forest; black bears, white-tailed deer, bobcats and salamanders.

parks.name: Chincoteague National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Barrier island beach and marsh; wild ponies, snow geese, sika deer and sea turtles.

parks.name: Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Dunes and bay marsh; snow geese, loggerhead turtles, ducks and bald eagles.

parks.name: Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Giant forested swamp; black bears, bobcats, warblers and turtles.

parks.name: False Cape State Park
parks.blurb: Remote beach and maritime forest; sea turtles, ghost crabs, deer and migrating birds.

parks.name: First Landing State Park
parks.blurb: Cypress swamp and beach; ospreys, turtles, herons and fiddler crabs.

parks.name: Mason Neck National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Potomac wetlands; one of the largest bald eagle nesting areas, herons and beavers.

parks.name: Great Falls Park
parks.blurb: Waterfalls on the Potomac; herons, deer, turtles and ospreys.

parks.name: Grayson Highlands State Park
parks.blurb: High balds with wild ponies; ponies, deer, grouse and salamanders.

parks.name: Pocahontas State Park
parks.blurb: Lakes and forest near Richmond; deer, turtles, bald eagles and beavers.

parks.name: Huntley Meadows Park
parks.blurb: Wetland boardwalk in Fairfax; beavers, herons, turtles and frogs.
